verdict.rationale: Aleph is an AI-native FP&A SaaS platform, and self-hosting is a fair axis for such a product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions self-hosted, on-premises, or customer-deployed options. The docs describe only a hosted trial, connectors and security features such as encryption, none of which concern deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
